description: Defines the Organization entity class for the OrangeHRM system, mapping to the 'ohrm_organization_gen_info' database table with properties like id, name, tax ID, registration number, contact details, location, and notes. Includes getter and setter methods for each property, facilitating ORM operations.

classes.name: Organization
classes.description: Entity class representing organizations within the OrangeHRM system, mapped to the database, with various address and contact fields.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the organization.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the organization.

methods.name: getTaxId
methods.description: Returns the tax ID of the organization.

methods.name: getStreet1
methods.description: Returns the first street address line.

methods.name: setStreet1
methods.description: Sets the first street address line.

methods.name: getStreet2
methods.description: Returns the second street address line.

methods.name: setStreet2
methods.description: Sets the second street address line.
